name: Sorry, Then Swearing
effect: Suppressing this layer-5 neuron makes the model drop the task. It answers with a stock "I'm sorry, you're right." or breaks into short, profane, hostile outbursts.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
